```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)

here::i_am("README.md")

network_folder <- here("data/clean/networks")
```


```{r}
network_paths <- list.files(network_folder, pattern = "\\.gml$", full.names = T)

df <- tibble()

for (file in network_paths) {
  name <- basename(file) %>% str_replace(".gml$", "")
  graph <- igraph::read_graph(file, format = "gml")
  nodes <- igraph::as_data_frame(graph, "vertices")
  nodes$network <- name
  df <- bind_rows(df, nodes)
}
```

```{r}
# join sentiment

sentiment_folder <- here("data/interim/title_sentiments")
sentiments <- lapply(
  list.files(sentiment_folder, full.names = T),
  function(x) read_csv(x, show_col_types = F)
)

sentiments <- bind_rows(sentiments)
```



```{r}
conspiracy_topics <- c(
  "plandemic", "5g_covid", "is_earth_flat", "pizzagate",
  "adrenochrome", "qanon", "chemtrails", "great_replacement_theory",
  "9_11_building_7", "death_elvis_presley"
)
noncontroversial_topics <- c(
  "how_to_draw", "ab_workout", "warrior_cats",
  "vintage_jewelry", "pokemon_go", "minecraft", "wordle", "van_life_us",
  "power_tools", "urban_gardening"
)
news_topics <- c(
  "dominion_voting_system", "roe_v_wade", "critical_race_theory",
  "johnny_depp_amber_heard_trial", "vaccine_mandate", "derek_chauvin",
  "baby_formula", "transgender", "antifa", "gas_prices"
)
science_topics <- c(
  "game_theory", "filter_bubbles", "nft", "climate_change",
  "monkeypox_virus", "nanotechnology", "blockchain", "machine_learning", "autism",
  "tourette_syndrome"
)
```


# Sentiment analysis

## by network


```{r}
senti_df <- df %>%
  left_join(sentiments, by = c("label" = "video_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    topic_group = case_when(
      network %in% conspiracy_topics ~ "conspiracy",
      network %in% noncontroversial_topics ~ "non-controversial",
      network %in% news_topics ~ "news",
      network %in% science_topics ~ "science"
    )
  )
```

```{r}

senti_df %>%
  group_by(topic_group, network) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_sentiment = mean(sentiment)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(network, avg_sentiment), y = avg_sentiment, fill = topic_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip()
```

## by topic group

```{r}
senti_df %>%
  group_by(topic_group) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_sentiment = mean(sentiment)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(topic_group, avg_sentiment), y = avg_sentiment)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip()
```

# Perspective API Analysis

```{r}
perspective_folder <- here("data/interim/perspective_data")
perspective <- lapply(
  list.files(perspective_folder, full.names = T),
  function(x) read_csv(x, show_col_types = F)
)

perspective <- bind_rows(perspective)

perspective_df <- df %>%
  left_join(perspective, by = c("label" = "video_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    topic_group = case_when(
      network %in% conspiracy_topics ~ "conspiracy",
      network %in% noncontroversial_topics ~ "non-controversial",
      network %in% news_topics ~ "news",
      network %in% science_topics ~ "science"
    )
  )
```


## by network


```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=7}

perspective_df %>%
  select(-c(PERSPECTIVE_FLIRTATION, PERSPECTIVE_THREAT)) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("PERSPECTIVE"), names_to = "perspective_type") %>%
  group_by(topic_group, network, perspective_type) %>%
  summarize(avg_val = mean(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=topic_group, y=avg_val, label=network)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", fill='#BED1DB', color='black') +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width=.2) +
  ylab('Avg. probability') +
  geom_text(color = '#658DA0', size=3, alpha=1) +
  facet_wrap(~perspective_type, ncol = 3, scales="free")
```
